request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
error[ZC-E0125]: a service's health check is not valid
  cause  health.timeout_ms is 5000, longer than health.interval_ms (2000)
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    correct the service file and apply it again
